rationale.consistency: Follows sibling cmd layout, license header and zoekt-git-index flag names; but list/remove hand-roll a -index flag instead of index.Options, and the gitindex change unconditionally lets a caller-set Name beat zoekt.name/origin config, which alters zoekt-git-index behaviour.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles bare repos, .git-file worktrees, root-as-repo, duplicate names and sorted output; but no-arg run returns an error without usage, compound shards are pruned wholesale if any repo is absent, and dry run still MkdirAlls the index dir and creates a lock file.
rationale.scope: Delivers discovery, preview/apply, list, remove, lock and help; adds an extra 'sync' subcommand and a larger prepareRepo/IsUpToDate refactor of the shared indexer than strictly needed.
rationale.readability: Small focused files, clear names, straightforward control flow; preview and apply loops repeat the same status printing.
rationale.robustness: flock-based non-blocking lock and closer handling are fine; os.Remove errors are silently discarded in apply mode, IsUpToDate errors are swallowed into 'needs indexing', and syscall.Flock is Unix-only.
rationale.maintainability: Index-dir default duplicated in three places, shard removal logic duplicated between sync and remove, and prepareRepo mutates opts through a pointer with repeated manual closer cleanup on error paths.
